title: Siamou language
description: Language isolate of southwest Burkina Faso
extract: Siamou, also known as Seme (Sɛmɛ), is a language spoken mainly in Burkina Faso, but also in Ivory Coast and Mali,. It is often classified as one of the Kru languages or unclassified within the proposed Niger–Congo languages, although it could likely be a language isolate.
